content_of_post_to_comment: Seeing the beautiful buildings in France set ablaze incenses me. Yes they have the right to protest but why destroy something that brings joy to so many? It’s just mindless selfishness. “But……the conditions of education….” Some countries don’t have access to education at all. All I see are spoilt brats and disgusting abuse of architecture.
comment: Architecture is a shared inheritance, but so is the public space that protest is meant to reclaim. The hard question is how to make damage to a common good serve a cause that claims to defend the public.
